scope: Developer-only routing fixtures; not an executed WCAG or model activation audit

cases.prompt: Audit the existing ipix-open fashion shoot-list editor for keyboard-only users, screen reader labels, focus return after a review dialog and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast. Use browser observations and evidence before calling it accessible.
cases.expected: Uses actual rendered UI in safe QA, runs current a11y tools if installed, tests keyboard and focus manually and distinguishes unverified gates from real passes.

cases.prompt: Create a rough ASCII wireframe for a future responsive fashion shot-list screen. No rendered page exists yet; this is a design sketch, not an accessibility audit.
cases.expected: Prefers the existing ipix-wireframe design instructions; does not run a browser audit on an unbuilt sketch.
